_doc: Design-specific power models of the medical front-end stress fixture.

models.source: Host board supplies +5 V (SELV) on pin 1 (spec).
SN6505B push-pull at 5 V with a 1:1.3 centre-tapped transformer: each half-secondary ≈ 1.3 × 5 V less the driver RDS(on) drop ≈ 6.2 V, winding + driver ≈ 1.5 Ω (TI SN6505 application data).
